prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [137].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 137 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: The cooler area will use numbers instead of names.
options.zh: 較涼的等候區會改叫號碼，不叫名字。
options.whyZh: 後段說主持人會在兩處叫同一批名字，不會另外叫號碼。

options.text: Guests should stay near the oven unless their names have already been called.
options.zh: 除非已被叫到名字，否則應留在烤爐旁。
options.whyZh: 較涼處就是給仍在等的人；後文說移過去不影響順序。

options.text: That area is only for anyone waiting to collect a board after baking.
options.zh: 那裡只供等著領回烘烤後的板子的人使用。
options.whyZh: 前文適用於任何覺得爐邊太熱的人，後文也說仍未輪到的人可在那裡等。

options.text: Follow the blue arrows to the benches by the entrance.
options.zh: 請沿藍色箭頭走到入口旁的長椅。
options.whyZh: 接著補上第二處等候區的方向；下一句再解釋在兩處叫同一批名字及原排序。

explanationZh: 接著補上第二處等候區的方向；下一句再解釋在兩處叫同一批名字及原排序。
evidence: There will be a second waiting spot tonight for anyone who finds that area too warm. / The host will call the same names at both spots, so moving to the cooler area won’t affect your place in line.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: There will be a second waiting spot tonight for anyone who finds that area too warm.
The host will call the same names at both spots, so moving to the cooler area won’t affect your place in line.

vocabulary.note: 指等待服務的順位，不一定真站成一列。
